267:     The correction domain is the union of
268:       (a) every endpoint of the 67 flagged edges whose R2 label differs from own_r1a,
269:       (b) every vertex whose label change is inside the {THUMB, INDEX} transition family,
270:     closed over the same-corrected-digit 1-ring and (only where the trusted-neighbour count is
271:     insufficient) the 2-ring.

277:     adjw = mesh_graph(V0, EDGES)
278:     adj = dict((k, [t[0] for t in v]) for k, v in adjw.items())
279:     flagged = set()

281:         flagged.add(a)

283:     core = set()

302:                   if u not in domain and part[u] == part[i])

310:     # would only move the weight discontinuity (round spec sections 13 / 14).
